gc.felder.title: Fields for the cultivator
gc.felder.short: Stake out a field with the cultivator: inside it the preview jumps to the next free spot, and holding E plants row by row.
gc.felder.body:
Choose “Mark field” in the cultivator's build menu: left click sets corner points, a click on the start point closes the field, right click takes the last point back, and Esc discards the drawing. When you then pick a seed, the preview inside the field jumps to the next free spot where the plant can grow, in rows parallel to the first edge and as dense as Valheim allows. Holding E plants one spot after another, even while walking, with Valheim's own click: costs, [[valheim.stat.stamina|stamina]] and [[valheim.skill.farming|Farming]] count as usual.

Everyone holding a cultivator sees the fields; with “Mark field” selected, a right click on a field removes it after a confirmation, and the plants stay. The mod is part of GC Server ([[gc.kern.stufe|level]] 3 “Vanilla+”) and only works if the server has it too; with PlantEasily it does not plant automatically.

gc.felder.fields.title: Switching fields on and off
gc.felder.fields.short: Two switches: the server rule allows fields on the server, and your own switch shows and uses them for you.
gc.felder.fields.body:
“Fields for the cultivator” is the [[gc.serverrules|server rule]]: when it is off, “Mark field” disappears for everyone, and fields are neither shown nor planted. “Show and plant fields” under “Fields: display” applies only to you, and so do colour and opacity of the area ({gc_felder_fields_fill}) and of the edge ({gc_felder_fields_line}); at night the colour is dimmed.

The server sets the other rules:
- Who may remove fields: everyone, creator and admins, creator with their guild leaders and admins, or admins only; without a guilds mod guild leaders don't count
- at most {gc_felder_fields_points} corner points per field and edges up to {gc_felder_fields_edge} (0 = unlimited)
- planting reaches {gc_felder_fields_reach} around you, every {gc_felder_fields_interval} while you hold E
- spacing for plants without their own growth rule: bushes {gc_felder_fields_bush}, mushrooms {gc_felder_fields_mushroom}, other {gc_felder_fields_other}
- always: edges may not cross, fields may not overlap, and no corner lies more than 100 m from the middle
